IGUI_perks_Ammo Making_Description: Knowledge and skill involved in crafting, inspecting and reloading ammunition.
IGUI_perks_Ammo Making_Description1: You can recognize basic ammunition components.
IGUI_perks_Ammo Making_Description2: You can roughly judge the quality of simple ammunition.
IGUI_perks_Ammo Making_Description3: You can identify basic casing and projectile defects.
IGUI_perks_Ammo Making_Description4: You can estimate whether ammunition is underloaded or overloaded.
IGUI_perks_Ammo Making_Description5: You can inspect primers and estimate cartridge reliability.
IGUI_perks_Ammo Making_Description6: You can estimate component quality with moderate accuracy.
IGUI_perks_Ammo Making_Description7: You can identify dangerous ammunition and probable failure types.
IGUI_perks_Ammo Making_Description8: You can estimate ammunition quality and reliability with high accuracy.
IGUI_perks_Ammo Making_Description9: You can identify subtle manufacturing defects and dangerous loads.
IGUI_perks_Ammo Making_Description10: You can precisely assess ammunition quality, reliability and failure risk.
